UPSTREAM: Documentation/Makefile.sphinx: Be cautious when running `rm -rf` If BUILDDIR were an empty string, running `make clean` would result in running `rm -rf /*`. Omitting the trailing /* prevents this. With a valid BUILDDIR, the behaviour of `make clean` changes slightly in that BUILDDIR itself is removed. However, this is probably more in line with what one would expect from `make clean`. device/audio: make LoadConfig work LoadConfig could not work when we have loaded a UCM config, and want to load a JSON / YAML audio config. This CL fixes the issue. Therefore, the argument `audio_conf` of pytest `audio_loop` will work properly. E.g., we can place a `headphone_audio.json` in py/config/, and only load this config when we are testing headphone. Otherwise, AudioController will use system UCM config.
